After work, I need to order groceries from the Whole Foods at 789 Broadway. The items I need are milk, bread, eggs, and apples. I don't want to spend more than $10 on delivery. Then, I need to get a ride from my office to my friend's house at 321 Elm Street, and I don't want to spend more than $20 on that ride. Finally, I need to get a ride from my friend's house back to my home, and I don't want to spend more than $25 on that ride. Can you help me with all of this?"
